inputs.text: Flat texture photograph, shot straight-on and filling the entire frame edge to edge: quilted linen aketon surface, medieval, used. Vertical quilting channels 4 cm apart, coarse undyed linen tabby weave, faint grime, no gloss. Even diffuse light, no shadows, no vignette, no perspective, no objects, no edges, no text.
